instruction: Candid cinematic medium shot of an outdoor backyard with hanging string lights. On the left, the man in the patterned t-shirt (R3), wearing a peach bandana and glasses, extends his hand in a scissors gesture. On the right, the woman in the pink shirt (R1) stands watching and smiling. An off-screen person's hand extends from the right edge to play rock-paper-scissors. Warm ambient light glows from the background.
